C1.rationale: Incorporating received feedback and flagging unverified items reads as general working practice or coordination rather than a distinct deliverable. Only two statements from two employees, so the evidence for a new requirement is thin.

C1.wording: Validated findings, including incorporated feedback and verification status
C1.rationale: Noting which received feedback has not yet been checked resembles marking validation status, which fits the validated findings deliverable. Widening that task would capture this without adding a new task.

C1.wording: Feedback incorporation log with verification status
C1.rationale: If tracking feedback and its verification state recurs as its own output, a small dedicated task could capture it. This option is weaker given the limited evidence.

C2.wording: No REQ change; one-off clarification work
C2.rationale: Single statement from one employee describing ad hoc clarification of an existing description. Recurrence and scope are too thin to justify a new requirement.
If the clarified descriptions are vulnerability or finding descriptions, the example-writing fits naturally within producing validated findings that readers interpret correctly.
The statement already aligns to the PMO task. Clarifying requirement descriptions with examples is requirements-control work, so it may belong to that task rather than this REQ.

C3.wording: No REQ change; assumption tracking is routine
C3.rationale: Only one statement from one employee. Flagging unverified assumptions is a normal part of analysis and does not show recurring, distinct work that needs its own requirement.

C3.wording: Validated findings with unverified assumptions flagged
C3.rationale: Marking which conclusions rest on unchecked assumptions fits naturally into producing validated findings. Widening the wording would capture it without adding a task.
The statement already aligns to the PMO task on risk and issue management. Open assumptions that still need checking can be tracked as risks or issues there, so no change is needed in this REQ.
